description: Edge Download Domain Isolation Specification for Muxaro User Content
purpose: Isolate untrusted user-generated and downloaded media artifacts to an isolated origin with strict anti-XSS headers

response_headers_transform_rule.name: Muxaro User Content Anti-XSS Isolation
response_headers_transform_rule.description: Mandatory anti-XSS, anti-sniff, and sandboxed headers for all user downloads

headers.name: Content-Type
headers.rationale: Prevents browsers from executing user content as HTML, SVG, XML, or script

headers.name: Content-Disposition
headers.rationale: Forces browser file download dialog and prohibits inline execution

headers.name: X-Content-Type-Options
headers.rationale: Prevents MIME-sniffing bypasses in modern browsers

headers.name: Content-Security-Policy
headers.rationale: Restricts script execution, forms, popups, and plugin execution even if rendered

headers.name: X-Frame-Options
headers.rationale: Prohibits framing inside iframes to defeat clickjacking

headers.name: Referrer-Policy
headers.rationale: Prevents download URLs and HMAC signature query tokens from leaking via Referer

headers.name: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy
headers.rationale: Permits authenticated cross-origin download requests while preserving isolation
